if.test: west != null and south != null and east != null and north != null

mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.osm_id, b.name, b.building_type, b.levels, b.height, b.height_source, b.base_altitude, b.created_at, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.footprint, 6) AS footprint_geo_json, ST_X(b.center) AS lon, ST_Y(b.center) AS lat FROM t_building AS b WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(jsonb_agg(feature.value), '[]'::jsonb) )::text FROM ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', b.id, 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(b.footprint, 6)::jsonb, 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'name', b.name, 'buildingType', b.building_type, 'levels', b.levels, 'height', b.height, 'heightSource', b.height_source, 'baseAltitude', b.base_altitude ) ) AS value FROM t_building AS b
ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{maxFeatures} ) AS feature
SELECT count(*) FROM t_building AS b
SELECT count(*) FROM t_building AS b

SELECT b.id, b.name, b.building_type, b.levels, b.height, b.height_source, ST_X(b.center) AS lon, ST_Y(b.center) AS lat FROM t_building AS b
AND b.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND b.building_type = #{buildingType}
ORDER BY b.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_building (name, building_type, levels, height, height_source, footprint, center) VALUES (#{building.name}, #{building.buildingType}, #{building.levels}, #{building.height}, #{building.heightSource}, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{building.lon} - #{halfExtent}, #{building.lat} - #{halfExtent}, #{building.lon} + #{halfExtent}, #{building.lat} + #{halfExtent}, 4326), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{building.lon}, #{building.lat}), 4326))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_building SET name = #{building.name}, building_type = #{building.buildingType}, levels = #{building.levels}, height = #{building.height}, height_source = #{building.heightSource}, footprint = ST_MakeEnvelope(#{building.lon} - #{halfExtent}, #{building.lat} - #{halfExtent}, #{building.lon} + #{halfExtent}, #{building.lat} + #{halfExtent}, 4326), center = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{building.lon}, #{building.lat}), 4326) WHERE id = #{building.id}
